translation: The elbow bone (肘骨) is the place where the upper and lower branch bones of the middle segment of the arm meet, commonly called the goose-nose bone (鵝鼻骨). If it is injured by a fall and the tip of the elbow protrudes upward, with unceasing pain, sweating, and shivering, use manual technique to turn the arm bone and pull the elbow bone to make it close the seam. For the obliquely bent sinew, push and massage it with the hand to make it level and restored; although it can then immediately hang down and be raised, one should still regard rest and recuperation as best.
